# events

|---|---|
| [`from-start-date`](#events-from-start-date) | Gets the list of events by start date |

## `events from-start-date`

Gets the list of events by start date

```
epm-cli events from-start-date [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Events/FromStartDate` · Response: `EpmEcsEventResponseModel`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--start-date` | string |  | Start Date(UTC) to search events from (Elastic Ingestion Timestamp in UTC). Example: 2022-08-12T17:34:28.694Z **(required)** |
| `--record-size` | integer |  | Maximum records that can be returned. Min size: 1, Max size: 1000, Example: 100 |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli events from-start-date --start-date <VALUE>
```

## `events search`

Gets the list of events by Filters

```
epm-cli events search [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Events/search` · Response: `EpmEcsEventResponseModel`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--start-date` | string |  | Start Date(UTC) to search events from (Elastic Ingestion Timestamp in UTC). Example: 2022-08-12T17:34:28.694Z **(required)** |
| `--end-date` | string |  | End Date(UTC) to search events from (Elastic Ingestion Timestamp in UTC). Example: 2022-08-12T17:34:28.694Z **(required)** |
| `--computer-groups` | list of UUID |  | The Id of the group(Guid format) |
| `--operating-system` | string |  | Os name **(required)** |
| `--event-action` | list of string |  | The action of the event |
| `--event-code` | list of string |  | The code of the event |
| `--event-type` | list of string |  | The type of the event |
| `--application-type` | string |  | The type of the application |
| `--host-name` | string |  | The host name of the computer |
| `--host-domain` | string |  | The host domain of the computer |
| `--user-name` | string |  | The name of the user |
| `--user-domain` | string |  | The domain of the user |
| `--workstyle-name` | string |  | The workstyle of the policy |
| `--application-group-name` | string |  | The application group name of the policy |
| `--on-demand-rule` | switch |  | Is on demand rule? |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli events search --start-date <VALUE> --end-date <VALUE> --operating-system <VALUE> --all -o json
```
